verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server letting AI agents interact with the Stripe API, and the Subscriptions API supports creating subscriptions, previewing prorations, and changing plans — covering much of the described agent workflow. However the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of scoped/restricted permission models for agent-issued API keys or MCP tool-level scoping, and no direct 'apply a credit' endpoint is cited. missing for 10: explicit scoped-permission/restricted-API-key documentation for agent access, explicit credit-application API evidence, independent verification of MCP agent billing actions working end-to-end.
